personalInfo.name: ADHAM AL MECHKOR
personalInfo.about: Full Stack Developer based in Tangier, Morocco, with hands-on experience shipping production web applications end-to-end — from responsive React/Next.js interfaces to Laravel and Node.js APIs. Comfortable owning a feature from requirements through UI, backend logic, and deployment. Currently building internal operations tooling (dashboards, tracking systems, and reporting automation) for pharmaceutical wholesale distributor Dawa Maghreb, alongside IT systems support — including a custom Rust driver for legacy printers — while continuing to deepen my skills in NestJS and cloud-native tooling.

experiences.title: Full Stack Developer
description: Sole developer of a suite of internal operations tools for pharmaceutical wholesale distribution — client scoring, real-time sales monitoring, employee and delivery-driver tracking, pharmacy-network tracking with map-based visualization, and production-floor TV dashboards — built with Next.js, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL (Prisma/Neon), and MySQL.
Lead developer of Tirage Contrôle, a React/TypeScript warehouse order-fulfillment tracker covering preparation, quality control, packing, and shipping stages, with an optional FastAPI backend.
Built a ClickUp reporting platform (FastAPI + React) that syncs project data from ClickUp and automatically delivers PDF reports via WhatsApp.

Wrote a Rust driver to interface with legacy dot-matrix printers for warehouse label and invoice printing, and support broader IT operations: networking, workstation setup, and printer/peripheral connectivity.
Build and maintain the company's product landing page (la-dawa) with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and Radix UI, translating Figma designs into production-ready components.
